% Pandoc template for the FMT VSB-TUO bachelor thesis replica.
% Do not edit by hand when writing the thesis; values come from
% thesis/metadata.yaml and the Markdown chapters in thesis/.
\DocumentMetadata{pdfstandard=a-2b, pdfversion=1.7, lang=cs-CZ}
\documentclass{fmt-thesis}

% --- helpers that pandoc's LaTeX writer relies on ---------------------------
\providecommand{\tightlist}{\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\makeatletter
\patchcmd\longtable{\par}{\if@noskipsec\mbox{}\fi\par}{}{}
\newsavebox\pandoc@box
\newcommand*\pandocbounded[1]{%
  \sbox\pandoc@box{#1}%
  \Gscale@div\@tempa{\textheight}{\dimexpr\ht\pandoc@box+\dp\pandoc@box\relax}%
  \Gscale@div\@tempb{\linewidth}{\wd\pandoc@box}%
  \ifdim\@tempb\p@<\@tempa\p@\let\@tempa\@tempb\fi
  \ifdim\@tempa\p@<\p@\scalebox{\@tempa}{\usebox\pandoc@box}%
  \else\usebox{\pandoc@box}%
  \fi}
\def\fps@figure{htbp}
% image paths in Markdown are relative to thesis/ (so they render on GitHub)
\graphicspath{{thesis/}}
% citeproc citations (pandoc): \citeproc{key}{rendered text}
\NewDocumentCommand\citeproctext{}{}
\NewDocumentCommand\citeproc{mm}{%
  \begingroup\def\citeproctext{#2}\cite{#1}\endgroup}
\let\@cite@ofmt\@firstofone
\def\@biblabel#1{}
\def\@cite#1#2{{#1\if@tempswa , #2\fi}}
\makeatother
$if(highlighting-macros)$
$highlighting-macros$
$endif$
$if(strikeout)$
\usepackage{luacolor}
\usepackage[soul]{lua-ul}
$endif$
$for(header-includes)$
$header-includes$
$endfor$

% --- metadata ----------------------------------------------------------------
$if(title)$\fmtsettitlecs{$title$}$endif$
$if(title-en)$\fmtsettitleen{$title-en$}$endif$
$if(author)$\fmtsetauthor{$for(author)$$author$$sep$, $endfor$}$endif$
$if(supervisor)$\fmtsetsupervisor{$supervisor$}$endif$
$if(program)$\fmtsetprogram{$program$}$endif$
$if(academic-year)$\fmtsetacademicyear{$academic-year$}$endif$
$if(place)$\fmtsetplace{$place$}$endif$
$if(date)$\fmtsetdate{$date$}$endif$
$if(page-count)$\fmtsetpagecount{$page-count$}$endif$
$if(assignment)$\fmtsetassignment{$assignment$}$endif$
$if(acknowledgements)$\fmtsetacknowledgements{$acknowledgements$}$endif$
$if(abstract)$\fmtsetabstractcs{$abstract$}$endif$
$if(keywords)$\fmtsetkeywordscs{$for(keywords)$$keywords$$sep$, $endfor$}$endif$
$if(abstract-en)$\fmtsetabstracten{$abstract-en$}$endif$
$if(keywords-en)$\fmtsetkeywordsen{$for(keywords-en)$$keywords-en$$sep$, $endfor$}$endif$

\hypersetup{pdftitle={$title$},pdfauthor={$for(author)$$author$$sep$, $endfor$},
  pdfsubject={Bakalářská práce, FMT VŠB-TUO}}

\begin{document}
\fmtfrontmatter
$if(symbols)$
\begin{fmtsymbols}
$for(symbols)$
$symbols.symbol$ & $symbols.unit$ & $symbols.description$ \\ \hline
$endfor$
\end{fmtsymbols}
$endif$
\fmtlists

$body$

\end{document}
